svg.text: Target design, not yet deployed. Purple lines follow a quarterly review from collection to sign-off and a confirmed removal.
Each quarter, Scheduler starts the Step Functions review campaign.
The collector reads Identity Center users, groups, and permission sets, plus IAM roles and users.
IAM Access Analyzer adds external access and unused access findings.
The package builder writes one review package per approver to S3 and records each item in DynamoDB.
SES sends each approver a sign-off link.
Approvers keep or remove each entitlement; the decision handler records approver and time.
A removal runs only after the owner confirms it; nothing is revoked automatically.
The finished campaign is saved as evidence; CloudTrail logs changes and CloudWatch alarms on overdue sign-offs.
